translation: Kudzikinura here izvi kwamuita Yahwe, iwe ruvanhu rwasara risina hungwaru? Haasi iye here baba wako, akakuwanira? Ndiye akakusika, ndiye akakugadzikisa.

tokens.surface: הֲלֹ֥אא הוּא֙ אָבִ֣יךָ קָּנֶ֔ךָ ה֥וּא עָֽשְׂךָ֖ וַֽיְכֹנְנֶֽךָ
tokens.gloss: Haasi iye here baba wako, akakuwanira? Ndiye akakusika, ndiye akakugadzikisa.
